mode.title: Mode
mode.description: newCarriers = companies that registered recently, newest first. search = every carrier matching your filters. lookup = specific carriers by DOT number.

daysBack.title: Registered within the last N days
daysBack.description: Only used by newCarriers mode. About 390 active carriers register per day, so 30 days is roughly 11,000 companies before filtering.

states.title: States
states.description: Two letter state codes, for example TX, CA, FL. Empty returns every state.

minPowerUnits.title: Minimum fleet size
minPowerUnits.description: Power units (trucks and tractors). Leave empty for any size. 1 keeps owner-operators, 6 skips them.

maxPowerUnits.title: Maximum fleet size
maxPowerUnits.description: Power units. Leave empty for any size.

carrierOperation.title: Operation type
carrierOperation.description: Interstate carriers cross state lines and are the larger buying market.

dotNumbers.title: DOT numbers
dotNumbers.description: Only used by lookup mode. One or more USDOT numbers.

requireContact.title: Only carriers with a phone or email
requireContact.description: On by default so you are never charged for a lead you cannot contact. About 53 percent of carriers publish a phone, 18 percent an email.

includeInactive.title: Include inactive carriers
includeInactive.description: Off by default. Half the census is carriers that no longer operate; they are useful for research but not for selling.

maxItems.title: Maximum carriers
maxItems.description: Hard cap on rows pushed and billed.
